args.title: Increase error toast visibility duration
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Adjust the dismissal duration for error toasts specifically, allowing them to remain visible longer than the default 5000 ms. This ensures that error messages have sufficient time to be read by users.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'ToastProvider' component sets 'aria-live="polite"' on the toast-stack which affects all toast kinds including 'error'. 'AUTO_DISMISS_MS' for toast dismissal is set to 5000 ms in the same component, leading to error toasts disappearing too soon.
